skills.desc: Declare agents, environments, skills, memory stores, deployments, and vaults as files in your repository and keep the API's resources in sync with them using ant apply.

skills.desc: "Official tools for building with the Claude API: client SDKs in seven languages, the ant CLI, and framework-specific libraries."

skills.desc: Anthropic provides a compatibility layer that lets you use the OpenAI SDK to test the Claude API. With a few code changes, you can evaluate Anthropic model capabilities.
